people.name: Dophkah
people.line: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings.

people.name: Sin
people.line: Wilderness area between Elim and Sinai

translations.web: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
translations.bsb: They set out from the Desert of Sin and camped at Dophkah.
translations.kjv: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
